Docs/Configurations

Configurations

Keep environment identity, control, camera inputs and recorded data compatible across the complete workflow.

Four contracts to keep together

ContractSource of truthWhat to preserve
Task identitytasks/config/collection_targets.py ↗The 10 complete tasks, 30 stage tasks and chosen end effector.
Embodimenttasks/config/hands.py ↗Robot UID, controller, ordered joints and action width.
Simulationtasks/config/sim_profiles.py ↗Control frequency, physics backend and task-specific episode horizon.
Policy inpututils/pixel_cameras.py ↗Camera preset, resolution, preprocessing and state channel order.

Run examples from the public repository root after installation. A configuration copied from another task can silently change the experiment even when the policy still produces an action of the right shape.

Resolve the selected stage

from utils.dex_scene_eval import registered_task_settings
from utils.dex_tasks import resolve_dex_task

env_id = "CabinetPouringOpenCabinet-Sharpa-v1"
settings = registered_task_settings(env_id)
task = resolve_dex_task(env_id)
print(settings)
print(task.robot_uids, task.max_episode_steps, task.action_dim)

registered_task_settings resolves a canonical stage's robot, pd_joint_pos controller and registered time limit without constructing a simulator. The Sharpa VLA registry in utils/dex_tasks.py ↗ also carries joint layouts and instructions. For complete tasks and non-Sharpa hands, check the task registration and tasks/config/hands.py ↗ instead of assuming a Sharpa-only adapter supports them.

Match the method, not the default viewport

The released image-policy paths use a fixed family scene view and the relevant wrist view. PPO and RLPD use 128 × 128 images; ACT, Diffusion Policy, GR00T and π0.5 use 256 × 256. The ordinary task camera can be a different view. Use the method's documented preset and renderer, not a diagnostic screenshot.

ACT and Diffusion Policy additionally need the checkpoint's camera-history offsets, image normalization and state layout. The pixel RL loaders hash the camera configuration and reject an incompatible dataset or checkpoint. See utils/camera_configs.py ↗, utils/pixel_cameras.py ↗ and the training recipes.

Record the resolved experiment

Save the source commit and local changes, current environment ID, robot UID, controller, backend, horizon, seed list, observation schema and camera configuration. Add the checkpoint hash, instruction-sampling rule and action normalization. Preserve the dataset integrity certificate rather than editing it to fit a changed environment.

For native-scene runs, save env.unwrapped.eval_background_manifest. Fingerprint compatibility includes explicitly measured, record-neutral transitions in tasks/config/fingerprint_lineage.py ↗; a task change that alters recorded behavior is not made compatible by renaming its fingerprint. Continue with Evaluation and the reproduction record.
